dedupe_keys.name: legacy snow load dataset long term measurements of roof and ground snow loads in norway 1966 1986

description: This dataset contains full-scale measurements of snow loads on building roofs and on the ground in Norway between 1966 and 1986: windward and leeward roof loads, ground loads, snow densities, roof geometry, exposure descriptors, and year and week of each observation. The measurements were made by Professor H. Høibø; Thomas Thiis (Norwegian University of Life Sciences) and Jan Potac (Multiconsult) digitised and standardised them from paper records, geolocated the buildings from archive notes and historical aerial imagery, and added elevation from national height data. Coverage is the measured buildings across Norway over two decades. Access: one small CSV on Zenodo, latest version 29 July 2026. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: metadata fields flag completeness and confidence in building identification and location, which vary. Simulation uses: calibrating roof-to-ground snow load factors and snow-load hazard models for building design and roof collapse risk under climate change. Related records: building fragility datasets and weather files for building simulation.
name: Legacy snow load dataset: long-term measurements of roof and ground snow loads in Norway (1966-1986)
provider: Norwegian University of Life Sciences and Multiconsult (Thomas Thiis, Jan Potac), from measurements by H. Høibø
